description: Fetch compressed attestation por leaf hash via Photon Indexer. Retorna leaf data decoded (subject, jurisdiction, status, authority, shdw_url, etc.) e flag verifying se payload Shadow Drive bate com payload_hash on-leaf. Usar pra audit verification (regulador) ou status check (issuer).

verifyPayload.description: Se true, faz GET no shdw_url do leaf, calcula SHA-256, compara com payload_hash gravado on-chain. Default false (skip pra latência).

name: fetch_composed_attestation
